title: HTTP/GRPC-Web: support dissecting chunked data in streaming reassembly mode
description:
## Background and Feature Enhancement

This feature makes the server stream messages of GRPC-Web over HTTP/1.1 can be dissected even the last chunk is absent.

Previous version Wireshark can not dissect grpc-web server stream messages if the HTTP response in chunked mode without TCP FIN (because HTTP dissector only reassembly at the end of HTTP message):

![server_stream_mode_not_dissected](/uploads/5be559e66f873907a9006d6433deda5e/server_stream_mode_not_dissected.png)

After applying this merge, long time lived server stream messages of GRPC-Web over HTTP/1.1 can be dissected:

![server_stream_mode_dissected](/uploads/517d54fc333ea0b57464e8410eb940ee/server_stream_mode_dissected.png)

> Note, server stream reassembly is supported in GRPC over HTTP/2.

## Change Details

HTTP dissector now supports dissecting chunked data in streaming reassembly mode. Subdissectors of HTTP can register itself in "streaming_content_type" dissector table for enabling streaming reassembly feature while this protocol messages are transferred in chunked encoding.

> Note, GRPC-Web has been registered in "streaming_content_type" dissector table while making it supporting stream mode in HTTP/2.

## About common streaming reassembly helper

The reassemble_streaming_data_and_call_subdissector() and relevant types added in reassemble.h/c.
That provides a simple way to reassemble the streaming data of a high level protocol that is not on top of TCP but on another protocol. That is originated from the mechanism of HTTP/2 streaming reassembly with a little enhancement. I move that in reassemble.h/c because I think other dissectors may use it in the future. Details about this please refer to the comments in reassemble.h/c.

notes.body:
Two test cases also added. One for testing server stream mode of grpc-web over http1.1 case and another for testing big message reassembly in server stream mode case.

To run test cases in windows like:

```
pytest --program-path .\run\RelWithDebInfo\ -k "grpc or http"
```

Capture file of grpc-web over http/1.1 server stream:

[browser-grpc-web-proto-http1-server-stream-partial.pcapng](/uploads/12ababde9aaff7f67116f0c3beeda03f/browser-grpc-web-proto-http1-server-stream-partial.pcapng)

The protobuf message types definition:

[greet.proto](/uploads/5b0b0d46658a967496d20bb06dd9351a/greet.proto)

commits_data.title: HTTP: support dissecting chunked data in streaming reassembly mode
commits_data.message:
HTTP: support dissecting chunked data in streaming reassembly mode

Subdissectors of HTTP can register itself in "streaming_content_type"
subdissector table for enabling streaming reassembly mode while
transferring in chunked encoding.

This feature enures the server stream messages of GRPC-Web
over HTTP/1.1 can be dissected even if the last chunk is absent.

commits_data.title: Reassembly: add types and functions to simplify streaming data reassembly
commits_data.message:
Reassembly: add types and functions to simplify streaming data reassembly

The reassemble_streaming_data_and_call_subdissector() and relevant types added.
That provides a simple way to reassemble the streaming data of a high level
protocol that is not on top of TCP but on another protocol.
